name: Equipment Plus Total Facility Solutions
old_description: My name is Gail Phelps and I am a co-owner along with my sister, Kay of GK Cafe & Catering. We've been in business now since 2009 and Equipment Plus has provided us an opportunity to take GK from an idea or dream into fruition. They are there. I mean, they called themselves a total business. They can provide all the... I call them a one-stop shop. And when you call on them and you get immediate response, their team is proficient, they're knowledgeable, they're skilled and they come... You can tell they have that care of Christ when they come in to serve, they don't have to say it. It's just in their demeanor and the way they respond.
about:
Equipment Plus Total Facility Solutions was founded in 1987 by Robbie Taylor in Greenville, North Carolina. The company remains under the leadership of the Taylor family, with Laura Taylor also playing a key role. From its start as a foodservice equipment dealer, it has grown into a total facilities solutions provider for eastern North Carolina.

The firm supplies commercial kitchen equipment, offers equipment rentals, sells smallwares and chemicals, and provides parts, service, and preventive maintenance around the clock. Its 20,000‑square‑foot corporate center houses a showroom, a service dispatch center, a parts inventory valued at more than $250,000, and a custom fabrication shop. A staff of over 30 technicians and salespeople covers a 2,200‑square‑mile service area that includes Greenville, Washington, Wilson, Rocky Mount, New Bern, and surrounding communities.

Customers range from independent restaurants and catering operations to craft breweries and brewpubs. Named clients include Local Oak Brewery, G&K Cafe & Catering, Dickenson Avenue Public House, and Uptown Brewing Company. The company also promotes energy‑efficiency solutions for foodservice facilities.

Equipment Plus distinguishes itself with a “one‑stop‑shop” model that combines sales, installation, service, and project management under one roof, and it emphasizes a ministry‑first culture that directs community outreach and employee wellbeing.
